notes: Salzburg: STATISTIK AUSTRIA median price of condominium flats, EUR per m2 of living area, one value per calendar year 2015-2025 (each stamped on 1 July), from land register transactions; the surrounding district is shown for comparison. Annual only: eleven points, so the series is short and the quarters between years are interpolated by the build. Small-area medians mix quality and location effects with price change, and a municipality is withheld when fewer than 10 transactions enter. Earlier years are revised by the publisher each year. Content processed by the site.
